lead: Each chapter has a number, a title and a line about what it covers. Numbers follow the order, so adding a chapter renumbers the rest.

chapters.title: Pick a theme
chapters.description: 25 themes share one set of content, so choosing one changes the look and nothing else.

chapters.title: Open with a hero
chapters.description: Say what the product is, who it is for and what to do next.

chapters.title: Show what it does
chapters.description: Feature grids and comparisons, where the claims get specific.

chapters.title: Back it up
chapters.description: Testimonials, logos and ratings that support the claims.

chapters.title: Ask for the next step
chapters.description: Calls to action, forms and newsletter sign-ups.

chapters.title: Close the page
chapters.description: Footers, legal links and contact details.
